propositions: Each attempted fallback candidate must emit exactly one OTel child span nested under the Agent model-request span, with zero-based ordering and no duplication from instrument_all.

Every candidate span must record outcome (raised/returned), provider-qualified model identity, and optional provider-reported usage; raised-span reasons must be sanitized through sanitize_diagnostic and contain no secrets or unsanitized bodies.
The bug-895c native-to-prompted downgrade must remain legible as two distinct Agent request spans (native raised, prompted returned) with no change to _pai_structured control flow.
Candidate span emission failures must be best-effort swallowed so fallback results, RunUsage, and propagated exceptions remain identical to tracing-off.
The existing ordered FallbackExceptionGroup, resolution classification, UsageLimits, pricing, and durable JSONL must remain unchanged by candidate instrumentation.
Tracing must be disabled-safe: base install without tracing-extra imports runs with no span dependency error.
